# A document with tables

A paragraph before the table, which must stay a paragraph.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| serve | serves a review page as a live document |
| edit | serves a markdown document as a live editor |
| wait | blocks until the reviewer asks, then prints what is pending |

## Alignment holds too

| left | center | right |
| :-- | :-: | --: |
| a | b | c |

A paragraph after the table.
